BiblicalUsage: Zebulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, and the Canaanites dwelt among them and became tributaries. One verse, one failure, and the name is kept.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the towns Zebulun failed to take are named so we will see the cost of an unfinished conquest.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
